questions.prompt: Why does Yuka ask Taro to meet her brother first?

title: Meeting someone new

turns.speaker: yuka
turns.text: たろうさん、今日、兄が来ます。私は仕事で遅くなりますから、先に会ってください。
turns.translation: Taro, my older brother is coming today. I'll be late because of work, so please meet him first.

turns.speaker: taro
turns.text: いいですよ。お兄さんはどんな服を着ていますか。
turns.translation: Sure. What is your brother wearing?

turns.speaker: yuka
turns.text: 白いシャツと黒いズボンです。青いかばんを持っています。
turns.translation: A white shirt and black trousers. He has a blue bag.

turns.speaker: taro
turns.text: 分かりました。電車は三時に着きますか。
turns.translation: All right. Does his train arrive at three?

turns.speaker: yuka
turns.text: 電車は三時ですが、会うのは三時十分にしてください。場所は駅の西口です。
turns.translation: The train arrives at three, but please meet him at ten past three. The place is the station's west exit.

turns.speaker: taro
turns.translation: Okay. I'll wait at the west exit.
